subtasks: Pick up the two T-shaped blocks, swap their positions, and place them back with the correct orientations.

Hold the pink T level and stationary in the left gripper. Use the right gripper to pick up the blue T and place it face up at the pink T's original position, with its stem pointing away from the robot and its crossbar toward the robot.

Place the pink T from the left gripper into the blue T's original footprint to the right of the blue block, face up, with its stem pointing left and slightly away and its crossbar on the right. Withdraw the open right arm to its starting pose. Release pink and return both fully open arms to their starting poses.
